title: 2026届高三英语听力仿真训练（20）｜职业体验
note: 原创仿真训练，按 2026 高考听力题型编写（第一节、第二节均播放两遍）。

sections.name: 第一节
sections.desc: 听下面5段对话。每段对话后有一个小题，从题中所给的A、B、C三个选项中选出最佳选项。听完每段对话后，你都有10秒钟的时间来回答有关小题和阅读下一小题。每段对话读两遍。

materials.label: 第1段材料
materials.transcript:
W: My cat has stopped eating and sleeps all day.
M: Bring her in on Saturday morning. Dr. Wu is on duty then.
W: How much is a check-up?
M: Eighty yuan, and the medicine is extra.
W: That's fine. I'll bring her at nine.

questions.text: When will the woman take her cat to the vet?

materials.label: 第2段材料
materials.transcript:
M: The school newspaper pays fifty yuan for each article.
W: I've written four this term. So that's two hundred?
M: Only three were printed. The fourth is still being checked.
W: Still, that's more than my pocket money.
M: You can collect the money on Friday.

questions.text: How much will the woman get?

materials.label: 第3段材料
materials.transcript:
W: You want to be a journalist, don't you?
M: I did. But after a week at the paper, I'm not sure. You write a story, and someone cuts it to three lines.
W: That sounds frustrating.
M: It is. But I still like asking questions. Maybe that part is worth it.

questions.text: How does the man feel about working at the paper?

options.A: He is sure he wants to leave.
options.B: He finds part of the work rewarding.
options.C: He thinks the work is easy.

materials.label: 第4段材料
materials.transcript:
W: Are you coming to Career Day on Friday? An architect is speaking.
M: Architecture? I thought I wanted to study medicine.
W: You can still come. He's bringing models of the new library.
M: All right. I'll sit at the back and listen.

questions.text: What will the man do on Friday?

materials.label: 第5段材料
materials.transcript:
M: My interview at the newspaper office is at half past two.
W: The bus takes forty minutes, and you should be ten minutes early.
M: So I'll leave at a quarter to two.
W: Better make it half past one. The traffic is terrible after two.
M: All right, half past one.

questions.text: What time will the man leave?

sections.name: 第二节
sections.desc: 听下面5段对话或独白。每段对话或独白后有几个小题，从题中所给的A、B、C三个选项中选出最佳选项。听每段对话或独白前，你将有时间阅读各个小题，每小题5秒钟；听完后，各小题将给出5秒钟的作答时间。每段对话或独白读两遍。

materials.label: 第6段材料
materials.transcript:
W: I'd like to volunteer at the community library. What kind of work is there?
M: We need people on Saturday afternoons to put books back on the shelves and help older readers with the computer.
W: I'm not very good with computers.
M: That's all right. We also need someone to read to children on Sunday mornings. Do you like children?
W: Yes. I read to my little brother every night.
M: How many hours each week?
W: Two hours on Sunday would be fine.
M: Good. The children are between four and seven, so keep the stories short.
W: I have a book of short stories at home.
M: We will show you the shelves first. Then come on Sunday at nine. The training takes half an hour, so bring your student card.

questions.text: What will the woman do at the library?
When should the woman arrive on Sunday?

materials.label: 第7段材料
materials.transcript:
M: Excuse me, Ms. Qian. You design schools. How long does a school take to build?
W: Two years on average. One year of drawing and talking, one year of building.
M: What is the hardest part?
W: Listening. Teachers want quiet rooms; children want space to run. I have to find a plan that gives both.
M: Do you need to be good at maths?
W: It helps, but drawing and talking to people matter more. Half my work is in meetings.
M: Do you ever visit the building site?
W: Every week. I wear a hard hat and check that the windows are where the drawings say.
M: What should I study at university, then?
W: Architecture, of course. But take a course in art too, and learn to explain your ideas simply.

questions.text: How long does a school take to build?
What does Ms. Qian say is the hardest part of her job?
What does Ms. Qian advise the student to learn?

materials.label: 第8段材料
materials.transcript:
W: You are twenty-six and already run a small animal clinic. Did you always want to be a vet?
M: No. I wanted to be a farmer. But we had a sick dog when I was twelve, and the vet explained everything to my parents, calmly, in simple words. I decided I wanted to be that person.
W: What is the hardest part of the job?
M: The owners. The animals cannot tell me what hurts. I have to read a cat's tail and a dog's ears, and then explain to people why the treatment costs so much.
W: Do you ever have to say no?
M: Sometimes. Last month a family wanted an operation that would not help their old dog. We talked for an hour, and they chose to keep him comfortable instead.

questions.text: What made the man decide to become a vet?

options.A: A vet's kindness when he was a boy.

questions.text: What does the man find hardest about his work?
What did the family decide to do last month?

materials.label: 第9段材料
materials.transcript:
W: Mr. Gu, I keep changing my mind. One week I want to study medicine, the next I want to teach history.
M: Both are good choices. Which do you enjoy more: the subject, or the people?
W: I love history. But I also like explaining it. Last term I helped my cousin with her exam, and I was happier than I am in most classes.
M: Then teaching might suit you better. Doctors help people too, but most of their day is with patients, not with ideas.
W: My parents worry about the pay.
M: Teachers earn less at the start, but the work is steady. And you can still study history for four years before you decide.
W: So which programme should I apply for?
M: Apply to both kinds of programmes if the deadlines allow. Visit a school and a hospital during the holiday, and talk to three people in each. Then write down what you missed.

questions.text: What does the woman keep changing?

options.C: Her mind about her future job.

questions.text: What made the woman happy last term?

options.A: Helping her cousin with an exam.

questions.text: What does Mr. Gu say about teachers' pay?

options.B: It is lower at the start.
options.C: It is the same in every school.

questions.text: What does Mr. Gu suggest the woman do?

options.C: Visit workplaces and talk to people.

materials.label: 第10段材料
materials.transcript: Yesterday I spent a day at a vet clinic for our work experience programme. I arrived at eight, and the first job was not exciting: six cages and the floor. Then a woman came in with a rabbit that had stopped eating. The vet let me hold it while she listened to its heart. My hands were shaking, and I was afraid of hurting it. She told me to hold it like a baby, close to my body. In the afternoon I watched an operation on a small dog. I could not see much, but I remember the quiet. Nobody talked unless it was necessary. At six I went home, tired and hungry. I still want to be a vet, but now I know the job is not only cats and dogs. It is also floors and cages.

questions.text: What was the speaker's first job of the day?
What did the vet tell the speaker to do?

options.C: Hold the rabbit close to her.

questions.text: How does the speaker feel about the job now?

options.A: She has given up her plan.
